It's less like we're defending and more like we're being...tested.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 17 ([[Challenge Trials]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Elite Hazmat''' is an enemy that first appears on Wave 23 of [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode, Wave 17 of [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode and [[Challenge Trials]]. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It is a stronger version of the [[Hazmat]], as it has higher health and in addition to its [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], it also has the [[Burn Immunity]]. ==Appearance== The '''Elite Hazmat''' has a dark green skin color. It wears a white and black hazmat suit, which consists of single glove, a vest, gas tank, shoes and a gas mask. It has three different walking animations that are randomly chosen when it spawns. ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Hunter]] can defeat this quite easily. *As this generally spawns in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Tesla]], [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against this. **Some of the mentioned towers also deal splash damage, meaning they can bypass its [[Defense]]. *Because of its immunities, knockback and freeze cannot be used to slow it down. **Stuns can still be used, but because of its [[Stun Immunity]] it will only be slowed down instead of fully stunned. **All others forms of stalling, like confusion or [[DJ Booth]]'s slowdown can still be used. *Because of its immunities, freeze and burn [[Defense]] dropping towers cannot drop its defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EliteHazmatStun.gif|Current stun animation (11 December 2024 – Present)
